hypothesis: Retaining the incumbent prediction for high-scoring uploads can recover some field wins while avoiding the broad regression of changing every prediction.
protocol: Test the same score rule on the best direct checkpoint of both matched arms. Use both D4 distributions. The alternative returns all 177 scores. Reuse the current display threshold.
promotion: Apply the current full-task limits and field gains. Also require that the fraction of incorrect suggestions among all master validation uploads rises by no more than 0.001. Measure latency before deployment.
